svg.title: A Mature Cohort Supporting the Base Case
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-mature-commercial-recovery-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: A Mature Cohort Supporting the Base Case; subtitle: Five nested stages connect screening discipline to $280,000 in annual service fees.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative mature annual cohort, not an observed conversion benchmark or a launch-year forecast. Counts are nested: 500 >= 200 >= 100 >= 40 >= 20. Each stage is a subset of the preceding stage. First-deal planning remains 6–24 months.; caption: Twenty collecting matters averaging $14,000 in earned fees produce $280,000 recognized revenue. At an assumed 25% fee, $1,120,000 collected for creditors underlies that revenue.; stages: label: Screened judgment records; value: 500 commercial judgment records receive initial document-based screening; numeric value: 500.0; detail: Starting cohort equals 100% of screened records. Record court identifiers, judgment dates, creditor authority, balances, and review dates without treating face value as operator revenue.; label: Qualified commercial files; value: 200 records satisfy documented authority, scope, and enforceability criteria; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Forty percent of screened records survive initial review. Exclude files with unresolved authority, expired enforcement rights, unaddressed stays, or activity outside permitted scope.; label: Creditor engagements; value: 100 qualified files become signed, document-complete creditor engagements; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Fifty percent of qualified files convert to engagements. Each has fee terms, expense limits, communications authority, and a defined attorney role where required.; label: Actionable asset cases; value: 40 engaged files support economically justified, lawful recovery action; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Forty percent of engagements show a reachable asset or credible voluntary-payment route after priority, exemption, bankruptcy, and cost review.; label: Collecting matters; value: 20 actionable matters generate cleared receipts and earned service fees; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Fifty percent of actionable cases collect within the modeled annual measurement window: 4% of initial records. Average collections of $56,000 per collecting matter at 25% yield $14,000 in recognized fees.

text.title: A Mature Cohort Supporting the Base Case
text.tspan: A Mature Cohort Supporting the Base Case

rect.title: label: Screened judgment records; value: 500 commercial judgment records receive initial document-based screening; numeric value: 500.0; detail: Starting cohort equals 100% of screened records. Record court identifiers, judgment dates, creditor authority, balances, and review dates without treating face value as operator revenue.

label: Qualified commercial files; value: 200 records satisfy documented authority, scope, and enforceability criteria; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Forty percent of screened records survive initial review. Exclude files with unresolved authority, expired enforcement rights, unaddressed stays, or activity outside permitted scope.

label: Creditor engagements; value: 100 qualified files become signed, document-complete creditor engagements; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Fifty percent of qualified files convert to engagements. Each has fee terms, expense limits, communications authority, and a defined attorney role where required.

label: Actionable asset cases; value: 40 engaged files support economically justified, lawful recovery action; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Forty percent of engagements show a reachable asset or credible voluntary-payment route after priority, exemption, bankruptcy, and cost review.

label: Collecting matters; value: 20 actionable matters generate cleared receipts and earned service fees; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Fifty percent of actionable cases collect within the modeled annual measurement window: 4% of initial records. Average collections of $56,000 per collecting matter at 25% yield $14,000 in recognized fees.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative mature annual cohort, not an observed conversion benchmark or a launch-year forecast. Counts are nested: 500 >= 200 >= 100 >= 40 >= 20. Each stage is a subset of the preceding stage. First-deal planning remains 6–24 months.
